name: YellowLab Stop Core Emails
author: ylt

sections.description:
YellowLab Stop Core Emails adds a focused settings page under Settings > Stop Core Emails, where administrators can disable selected native WordPress email notifications.

You can manage email notifications for:

  • automatic plugin updates
  • automatic theme updates
  • automatic WordPress core updates
  • available core update notices
  • new user notifications sent to administrators
  • user password changes
  • password change notices sent to administrators
  • user email address changes
  • site administrator email address changes
  • new comments
  • comments waiting for moderation
  • critical error and recovery mode messages

The plugin does not block updates, user actions, comments, or recovery features. It only disables the selected email notifications.

After activation, open Settings > Stop Core Emails or use the Settings link on the Plugins screen.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP file from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Stop Core Emails.
  4. Choose which notifications to disable and save your changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin stop WordPress updates?

No. It only stops selected email notifications. Updates continue to run normally.

Does this plugin block emails from third-party plugins?

Not necessarily. Notifications sent by third-party plugins, WooCommerce, hosting systems, or external services may not pass through WordPress core filters.

Where can I find the settings page?

Go to Settings > Stop Core Emails in the WordPress admin area.
